payload.title: Rust schema DSL/macros + canonical AST parity
payload.description: Design and implement schema authoring in Rust (derive macros / builder DSL) that produces the same canonical schema AST as today's schema.ts pipeline. Schema identity hashing must be bit-identical so existing schemaHash values are reproducible from equivalent Rust schemas. Include the breaking-change linter semantics (docs/versioning.md, schema-author-tutorial.md). This is the foundation for codegen and for app authoring.
